gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM); Grade 3 Isocitrate Dehydrogenase (IDH) Wildtype Astrocytoma; Grade 3 or 4 Astrocytoma; Glioblastoma Surgery
Male or female subjects having histologically confirmed IDH wildtype glioblastoma (Parts 1 and 2), or grade 3 or 4 IDH mutant astrocytoma (Part 1 only) per WHO criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a 2-part multicenter Phase 1b study designed to test the safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics of single agent oral icapamespib in patients with recurrent brain lesions.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Study of Icapamespib (PU-AD) in Patients With Recurrent Malignant Glioma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Icapamespib Plasma Concentration at Time of Surgery: Tissue samples collected at surgery after icapamespib treatment.
with at least 5 subjects clinically requiring reoperation for tumor progression (Part 2)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: will be enrolled to evaluate the safety, pharmacokinetics (PK), pharmacodynamics, and MTD of single agent oral icapamespib administered daily.

role_evidence.quote: Icapamespib will be administered orally once daily for each 28-day cycle. The initial dose in this trial will be 20 mg

source_quote.quote: Male or female subjects having histologically confirmed IDH wildtype glioblastoma (Parts 1 and 2), or grade 3 or 4 IDH mutant astrocytoma (Part 1 only) per WHO criteria

coder_notes: Population mixes IDH-wildtype glioblastoma (both parts) and IDH-mutant grade 3/4 astrocytoma (Part 1 only); IDH status defines diagnosis/part, not candidate-matched. tumour_pk_planned coded yes because the PK outcome at surgery says tissue samples are collected, although the outcome title says plasma concentration (conflicting; could be unclear). target_engagement_planned yes on a stated pharmacodynamic objective for icapamespib, but no PD marker or sample type is specified (could be unclear). Hsp90 class inferred from exclusion of prior Hsp90 inhibitors; no antitumour mechanism stated.
